title: Confidential Settlement Agreement and Release of All Claims
text:
CONFIDENTIAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND RELEASE OF ALL CLAIMS

This Confidential Settlement Agreement and Release of All Claims (hereinafter "Agreement") is entered into as of the 15th day of March, 2025, by and between:

1. RODNEY J. MITCHELL (hereinafter "Plaintiff"), an individual residing at 3421 Oak Hollow Drive, Austin, Texas 78701; and

2. COASTAL FREIGHT LOGISTICS, LLC, Inc. (hereinafter "Defendant"), a Texas limited liability company with its principal place of business at 7890 Industrial Parkway, Houston, Texas 77002, and its insurer, LONE STAR INDEMNITY CORPORATION (hereinafter "Insurer"), a corporation organized under the laws of Texas.

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Plaintiff was involved in a motor vehicle accident on February 10, 2024, at the intersection of Interstate 35 and Riverside Drive in Travis County, Texas, when a tractor-trailer owned by Defendant and operated by its employee, Marcus D. Villanueva, collided with Plaintiff’s vehicle;

WHEREAS, Plaintiff sustained serious personal injuries, including a herniated disc at L4-L5, a fractured left tibia, and soft tissue damage to the cervical spine;

WHEREAS, Plaintiff filed a personal injury lawsuit styled Rodney J. Mitchell v. Coastal Freight Logistics, LLC, Inc., Cause No. D-1-GN-24-003847, in the 201st Judicial District Court of Travis County, Texas, before the Honorable Judge Merriweather;

WHEREAS, the parties have agreed to compromise and settle all claims arising from the accident to avoid the expense and uncertainty of litigation;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

1. SETTLEMENT PAYMENT. Defendant and Insurer shall pay to Plaintiff the sum of Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($250,000.00) (the "Settlement Amount"), payable within ten (10) business days of full execution of this Agreement. The Settlement Amount shall be delivered via wire transfer to the trust account of Plaintiff’s counsel, HARGRAVE & SANCHEZ, PLLC, at Bank of America, ABA No. 026009593, Account No. 4892017563.

2. RELEASE OF CLAIMS. Plaintiff, on behalf of himself, his heirs, executors, administrators, and assigns, hereby fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant, Insurer, and their respective officers, directors, employees, agents, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, costs, and expenses of any kind whatsoever, whether known or unknown, arising out of the accident described above, including but not limited to claims for bodily injury, pain and suffering, medical expenses, lost wages, and property damage.

3. NO ADMISSION OF LIABILITY. This Agreement is a compromise settlement of disputed claims and shall not be construed as an admission of liability by Defendant or Insurer. 

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and conditions of this Agreement shall remain confidential and shall not be disclosed by any party except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, or as required by law.

5. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Texas. Any dispute arising hereunder shall be resolved in the courts of Travis County, Texas.

6. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements, whether oral or written.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first above written.

________________________________
Rodney J. Mitchell
Plaintiff

________________________________
For Coastal Freight Logistics, LLC, Inc.
By: Harold T. Whitfield, Chief Operations Officer

APPROVED AS TO FORM:

________________________________
Lydia M. Hargrave
Attorney for Plaintiff
Hargrave & Sanchez, PLLC
100 Congress Avenue, Suite 1500
Austin, Texas 78701
Phone: (512) 555-0182
Email: lydia.hargrave@hargravesanchez.com

________________________________
Jonathan P. Crenshaw
Attorney for Defendant
Crenshaw & Associates, P.C.
2000 McKinney Street, Suite 300
Houston, Texas 77002
Phone: (713) 555-0927
Email: jcrenshaw@crenshawlaw.com

EXHIBIT A: MEDICAL RELEASE AUTHORIZATION

I, Rodney J. Mitchell, hereby authorize any healthcare provider, hospital, or health insurer to release to Hargrave & Sanchez, PLLC, all medical records and billing information related to my treatment from February 10, 2024, to present. My date of birth is July 14, 1985. My Social Security Number is 458-72-1936.

________________________________
Rodney J. Mitchell

EXHIBIT B: LIEN WAIVERS AND DISBURSEMENTS

All medical liens are to be satisfied from the Settlement Amount. The following disbursements are authorized: (a) Attorneys’ fees of $83,333.33 to Hargrave & Sanchez, PLLC; (b) Medical lien payoff of $45,000.00 to St. David’s Medical Center; (c) Medical records retrieval fee of $350.00 to MedLegal Services, Inc.; (d) Net to Plaintiff: $121,316.67.

Case law supporting the settlement includes Martin v. Coastal Freight, 987 S.W.3d 214 (Tex. App.—Austin 2023), wherein the Third Court of Appeals upheld a jury verdict for a plaintiff injured in a trucking accident, and Mitchell v. Southwestern Transport, 45 F.4th 876 (5th Cir. 2022), which addressed the scope of vicarious liability for common carriers. The parties also rely on Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code § 33.012 regarding settlement credits. title: Stipulation of Settlement and Mutual Release
text:
STIPULATION OF SETTLEMENT AND MUTUAL RELEASE

This Stipulation of Settlement and Mutual Release ("Stipulation") is made and entered into this 22nd day of April, 2025, by and among:

A. YOLANDA FERNANDEZ (hereinafter "Claimant"), an individual residing at 5540 Mesa Verde Lane, El Paso, Texas 79912;

B. DESERT PEAK CONSTRUCTION CO. d/b/a Desert Peak Builders (hereinafter "Company"), a Texas corporation with its principal office at 1200 Commerce Drive, Suite 400, El Paso, Texas 79902; and

C. JAMES D. HORTON (hereinafter "Employee"), an individual residing at 2301 Sunflower Road, Las Cruces, New Mexico 88001.

RECITALS

WHEREAS, on June 8, 2023, Claimant was employed by Company as a laborer at a construction site located at 8900 Montana Avenue, El Paso, Texas, when she was struck by a falling scaffolding component, causing severe injuries to her right shoulder, left wrist, and lumbar spine;

WHEREAS, Claimant filed a personal injury action against Company and Employee in the 34th Judicial District Court of El Paso County, Texas, styled Yolanda Fernandez v. Desert Peak Construction Co. d/b/a Desert Peak Builders and James D. Horton, Cause No. 2023-DCV-04512;

WHEREAS, the case was assigned to Judge Raymond K. Stoller, and the parties have engaged in mediation before Justice Harold M. Garner, Retired, of the Eighth Court of Appeals;

WHEREAS, to avoid further litigation, the parties wish to settle all claims;

NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows:

1. SETTLEMENT PAYMENT. Company and Employee, jointly and severally, shall pay to Claimant the sum of Four Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars ($425,000.00). Payment shall be made by wire transfer to the escrow account of Claimant’s counsel, Delgado & Kim, P.C., at First National Bank of El Paso, routing number 112233445, account number 7856341290, within fifteen (15) days of execution.

2. RELEASE. Claimant releases Company, Employee, and all related entities from any and all claims arising from the accident, including claims under the Texas Workers’ Compensation Act and any common law negligence claims.

3. DISMISSAL. Upon payment, Claimant shall file a notice of dismissal with prejudice in the action.

4. INDEMNIFICATION. The parties agree to indemnify and hold harmless each other from any claims brought by third parties related to this settlement.

5. CONSTRUCTION. This Stipulation shall be interpreted under Texas law, and any disputes shall be heard in El Paso County, Texas.

IN WITNESS, the parties sign below.

________________________________
Yolanda Fernandez
Claimant

________________________________
For Desert Peak Construction Co. d/b/a Desert Peak Builders
By: Samuel T. Ochoa, President

________________________________
James D. Horton
Employee

APPROVED:

________________________________
Carmen Delgado
Attorney for Claimant
Delgado & Kim, P.C.
200 East San Antonio Avenue, Suite 500
El Paso, Texas 79901
Phone: (915) 555-2341
Email: cdelgado@delgadokim.com

________________________________
Robert L. Montoya
Attorney for Company and Employee
Montoya & Mills, LLP
400 West Main Street, Suite 200
El Paso, Texas 79901
Phone: (915) 555-7845
Email: rmontoya@montoyamills.com

EXHIBIT A: MEDICAL RECORDS AUTHORIZATION AND RELEASE

I, Yolanda Fernandez, authorize the release of my medical records from Providence Memorial Hospital, including all records related to my injury on June 8, 2023. My date of birth is November 3, 1992. My Social Security Number is 529-18-4473.

EXHIBIT B: LIEN AND DISBURSEMENT SCHEDULE

(1) Attorneys’ fees and costs: $141,666.67 to Delgado & Kim, P.C. (2) Medical lien to Texas Tech Physicians: $52,000.00. (3) Medicare lien: $8,500.00. (4) Net to Claimant: $222,833.33.

Relevant authority: Fernandez v. Horton, 610 S.W.3d 112 (Tex. App.—El Paso 2022) (holding that an employer may be vicariously liable for an employee’s negligence), and Stoller v. Desert Peak, 78 F. Supp. 3d 654 (W.D. Tex. 2021) (discussing duty of care on construction sites). Texas Labor Code § 406.034 governs the exclusivity of workers’ compensation remedies. The parties acknowledge that this settlement is a compromise of disputed claims. title: Compromise Settlement and Covenant Not to Execute
text:
COMPROMISE SETTLEMENT AND COVENANT NOT TO EXECUTE

This Compromise Settlement and Covenant Not to Execute ("Settlement") is entered into on the 10th day of May, 2025, by and between:

MARGARET L. CHEN (hereinafter "Claimant"), residing at 8702 Rolling Hills Drive, Dallas, Texas 75201; and

TRINITY HEALTHCARE SYSTEMS, INC. (hereinafter "Hospital"), a corporation operating at 4500 Medical Center Drive, Dallas, Texas 75235, and its employee, DR. ANDREW J. VASQUEZ, M.D., an individual residing at 3321 Park Lane, Dallas, Texas 75204.

RECITALS

WHEREAS, on September 12, 2023, Claimant underwent a surgical procedure at Hospital performed by Dr. Vasquez, during which a surgical sponge was negligently left in Claimant’s abdominal cavity, resulting in a severe infection, a second surgery, and permanent scarring;

WHEREAS, Claimant filed suit against Hospital and Dr. Vasquez in the 160th Judicial District Court of Dallas County, Texas, styled Margaret L. Chen v. Trinity Healthcare Systems, Inc. and Andrew J. Vasquez, M.D., Cause No. DC-24-01877;

WHEREAS, the case was presided over by Judge Clarissa M. Nguyen, and the parties attended mediation with Justice R. Thomas Wainwright, Retired, of the Fifth Court of Appeals;

WHEREAS, the parties desire to settle the matter without further litigation;

AGREEMENT

1. SETTLEMENT AMOUNT. Hospital and Dr. Vasquez shall pay Claimant the total sum of Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($750,000.00). Payment shall be made within thirty (30) days to the trust account of CLAIMANT’S counsel, BAKER & WONG, LLP, at Wells Fargo Bank, account number 9012345678, routing number 121000248.

2. COVENANT NOT TO EXECUTE. Claimant agrees not to execute any judgment or pursue any further legal action against Hospital or Dr. Vasquez regarding the incident.

3. RELEASE. This release extends to all known and unknown claims.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms are strictly confidential.

5. GOVERNING LAW. Texas law applies.

SIGNATURES

________________________________
Margaret L. Chen
Claimant

________________________________
For Trinity Healthcare Systems, Inc.
By: Patricia D. Nguyen, Chief Legal Officer

________________________________
Andrew J. Vasquez, M.D.
Individual Defendant

APPROVED:

________________________________
Jeffrey S. Baker
Attorney for Claimant
Baker & Wong, LLP
300 North Ervay Street, Suite 1200
Dallas, Texas 75201
Phone: (214) 555-3019
Email: jbaker@bakerwong.com

________________________________
Gloria A. Treviño
Attorney for Hospital and Dr. Vasquez
Treviño & Associates, P.C.
500 Main Street, Suite 800
Dallas, Texas 75202
Phone: (214) 555-6987
Email: gtrevino@trevinoassociates.com

EXHIBIT A: RELEASE OF MEDICAL RECORDS

I, Margaret L. Chen, authorize Baylor University Medical Center to release all records to my counsel. My date of birth is January 28, 1969. My Social Security Number is 612-55-8943.

EXHIBIT B: DISBURSEMENTS

(1) Attorneys’ fees: $250,000.00. (2) Medical lien to Parkland Health: $175,000.00. (3) Expert witness fees: $15,000.00. (4) Net to Claimant: $310,000.00.

Relevant legal authorities: Chen v. Vasquez, 998 S.W.3d 405 (Tex. App.—Dallas 2024) (discussing res ipsa loquitur in retained foreign object cases), and Nguyen v. Trinity Healthcare, 56 F.4th 345 (5th Cir. 2023) (addressing corporate liability for employee negligence). Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code § 74.251 sets the statute of limitations for healthcare liability claims. title: Settlement and Hold Harmless Agreement
text:
SETTLEMENT AND HOLD HARMLESS AGREEMENT

This Settlement and Hold Harmless Agreement ("Agreement") is made this 5th day of June, 2025, by and among:

(1) PAUL D. GRANT (hereinafter "Plaintiff"), residing at 1220 Riverbend Drive, Fort Worth, Texas 76102;

(2) KELLER BROS. LOGISTICS, LP (hereinafter "Carrier"), a Texas limited partnership with principal offices at 5600 Railhead Avenue, Fort Worth, Texas 76103;

(4) GOLDEN STATE INSURANCE COMPANY (hereinafter "Insurer"), a California corporation authorized to do business in Texas.

RECITALS

WHEREAS, on December 14, 2023, Plaintiff was driving his vehicle northbound on Interstate 35W near the Belknap Street exit in Fort Worth, Texas, when a commercial truck owned by Carrier and operated by Driver rear-ended Plaintiff’s vehicle, causing Plaintiff to suffer a traumatic brain injury, cervical spine herniation, and post-traumatic stress disorder;

WHEREAS, Plaintiff initiated a lawsuit styled Paul D. Grant v. Keller Bros. Logistics, LP and Jennifer L. Stokes, Cause No. 2024-045892, in the 352nd Judicial District Court of Tarrant County, Texas, before Judge Steven M. Archer;

WHEREAS, the parties have agreed to settle the dispute;

TERMS

1. SETTLEMENT PAYMENT. Carrier, Driver, and Insurer shall pay Plaintiff the sum of One Million Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($1,250,000.00). Payment shall be made by wire to the IOLTA account of Plaintiff’s counsel, Morrison & Hart, P.C., at Frost Bank, account number 5678901234, routing number 114900075.

2. HOLD HARMLESS. Plaintiff agrees to hold Carrier, Driver, and Insurer harmless from any further claims.

3. RELEASE OF ALL CLAIMS. Plaintiff releases all claims, including those for punitive damages.

4. NO ADMISSION. This is not an admission of liability.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. The settlement terms shall remain confidential.
